# Holostaff AI Documentation

> Holostaff creates workflow autopilots for software products. An autopilot is a
> "Do it for me" button on a workflow. The user hands over the task. The autopilot
> completes it on screen, in the user's own session. Autopilots are built and
> certified by synthetic users before any human meets them, and deployed with one
> pull request.

Docs: https://docs.holostaff.ai/
Website: https://www.holostaff.ai/
CLI: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@holostaff/cli
Contact: hello@holostaff.ai

## The lifecycle

1. Map: one scan (`npx @holostaff/cli`) turns the repo into a journey map of the
   product's workflows. Source code never leaves the machine; a trust report
   itemizes the artifact before upload.
2. Rehearse: synthetic users (AI personas in real browsers) walk the real flows
   against a registered environment and show the team what breaks.
3. Certify: suites gate every PR, two levels per workflow. Level 1: synthetic
   users complete the workflow themselves. Level 2: they hand it to the autopilot
   and it completes it. Both must pass before deploy.
4. Deploy: one PR adds the SDK (offer card, handover loop, safety envelope).
   Certified autopilots go live with a toggle; off stops new offers instantly.
5. Verify: every handover is logged, verified against the workflow's goal state,
   and only counted (and billed) when complete.

## The safety envelope

- The autopilot runs in the user's own session, same origin, user's own
  permissions. No credentials pass through Holostaff.
- Payment, password, and code fields are hard-refused: the autopilot points, the
  user types.
- Consequential clicks (pay, delete, send, sign) wait for the user's Allow.
- Questions appear beside the field they concern, never over the form.
- Any keystroke pauses the run. Stop is always on screen. Hard step budgets cap
  every run.

## Pricing

Two meters, nothing else: simulation runs (build and certify; our-cloud runs
count 3) and completed handovers (a handover that stops, fails, or is handed
back costs nothing). Creation is never metered. Team $99/mo (300 runs, 100
handovers). Growth $299/mo (1,500 runs, 500 handovers). 14-day trial, card
required, trial usage free.
